post.summary:
True when the current session is a "ghost" account-user — i.e. a group-app /
head-office user who logged into this (child) account via switchToAccount
rather than being a real member of it. This is a session-TYPE predicate, NOT
an authorisation check: a ghost account_users row is only ever created once
the user's group-app visibility privilege (login_to_sub_accounts on a parent,
or an account-group privilege-set assignment) has been enforced upstream at
token creation, so a ghost session is proof that privilege already held — do
not treat this as a substitute for a privilege check. Used to grant such users
seat-free access to AI Prospecting (CRM-13865).

post.summary: Retrieves possible duplicate records based on parameters passed in
post.description: Retrieves possible duplicate records based on parameters passed in

email.description: The email address to check (will return records that have a 1:1 match)

phone.description: The phone number to check (will return records that have a 1:1 match)

name_first.description:
The first name of a contact (will return records that have a 1:1 match -
if name_last also provided, parameters are used together)

name_last.description:
The last name of a contact (will return records that have a 1:1 match -
if name_first also provided, parameters are used together)

contact_type.description: (optional) Limit duplicate checking to either a person or company

min_user_relationship_to_contact.description:
(optional) If provided (none,
read, update, owner), will filter results to only include contacts that the user has at least this
level of relationship with. Must be one of: 'none', 'read', 'owner', 'update'

match_behaviour.description:
(optional)
- "classic": must match on name and phone, name and email, or phone or email. if full name provided but
  email or phone is not, no result will be returned. Behaviour is different when only first or last name
  is provided.
- "strict": if name is provided, must match name AND (phone OR email) if either are provided

head-office user who logged into this (child) account via switchToAccount

seat-free access to AI Prospecting (CRM-13865).

order_by.description: An array keyed by field name with a value of either ASC|DESC

offset.description: The number of rows to offset

limit.description: The number of rows to return

create_viewstate.description: True if a viewstate should be created, false to just return the records

result_format.description: Any of the search result formats available for this service

extra_options.description: An array of extra options (only used for certain services). Call describeModel for more info - if the search_extra_options key is not present, it is not support for that service.

search_state.description: (DEPRECATED - provide system_record_state as a criteria instead)

ids_only.description: (DEPRECATED - use search_result_format:'ids' instead) If set to true, returns ids of matching records only - no actual rows

post.description: Update the record. To remove sub records include the _destroy flag

data.description: An array of data to add to the record

id.description: ID of the property to update

adr_unit_number.description: Property unit number or the lot number if the property category is land or rural

adr_street_number.description: Property street number - required for residential properties

adr_locality.description: Property locality - always null for AU properties

adr_country.description: Property country (aus|nz|uk) - will be set automatically from account settings if not provided

adr_latitude.description: Property latitude - calculated automatically from address if not provided

adr_longitude.description: Property longitude - calculated automatically from address if not provided

id.description: The id of the building/site in which the property exists
Property category id (valuelist: property_category)

meta_rates_council_exempt.description: Whether the property is exempt from council tax - available in UK only

meta_rates_domestic.description: Domestic rates - available in Northern Ireland

meta_tax_band.description: Tax band the property falls under - available in UK only (valuelist: property_tax_band)

meta_council_authority.description: The council authority of the property - available in UK only

is_dnd.description: Whether the property owner has requested no contact regarding this property

business_name.description: Property business name - only available for business properties

attr_bedrooms.description: Number of bedrooms - only residential properties

attr_bathrooms.description: Number of bathrooms - only residential properties

attr_ensuites.description: Number of ensuites - only residential properties

attr_toilets.description: Number of toilets - only residential properties

attr_living_areas.description: Number of living areas - only residential properties

attr_garages.description: Number of garages - only residential properties

attr_carports.description: Number of carports - only residential properties

attr_open_spaces.description: Number of open spaces - only residential and commercial properties

attr_floor.description: The floor on which the property is located in a multi-story building

attr_stories.description: Number of stories in the property

attr_buildarea.description: Property build area - not available for land properties

attr_buildarea_m2.description: Property build area m2 - not available for land properties

attr_buildarea_unit_id.description: Property build area unit type (valuelist: unit_of_area_building)

attr_landarea_unit_id.description: Property land area unit type (valuelist: unit_of_area_land)

attr_energy_rating.description: Property energy rating - only AU and NZ commercial properties

attr_build_year.description: Property build year - only available for residential properties

attr_sleeps.description: Number of people who can sleep at the property

attr_roi_pa.description: Property return on investment per annum - only commercial properties

attr_valuation_date.description: Property valuation date performed by registered valuer

attr_valuation_amount.description: The valuation amount for the entire value of the property performed by registered valuer

attr_valuation_land_amount.description: The valuation amount for the land component only performed by registered valuer

attr_is_house_land.description: Whether the property is a house and land package

attr_is_franchise.description: Whether the property is a franchise

attr_land_frontage.description: Property frontage - only available for land properties

attr_whole_part_id.description: Whether it is whole or part of the building (valuelist: property_part)

attr_tenure_ground_rent_review_year.description: Property tenure ground rent review year - available in UK only

attr_tenure_ground_rent_increase_percent.description: Property tenure ground rent increase as percentage - available in UK only

attr_shared_ownership_percentage.description: Shared ownership percentage - available in UK only

attr_shared_ownership.description: Whether the property is shared ownership - available in UK only

attr_shared_ownership_rent.description: Shared ownership rent amount - available in UK only

attr_shared_ownership_rent_period_id.description: Shared ownership rent frequency (valuelist: shared_ownership_rent_period) - available in UK only

attr_primary_sewerage_id.description: List of available sewerage types (valuelist: property_sewerage_supply) - available in UK only

attr_primary_water_supply_id.description: List of available water supply types (valuelist: property_water_supply)- available in UK only

attr_primary_electricity_supply_ids.description: List of available electricity supply types (valuelist: property_electricity_supply)- available in UK only

attr_broadband_ids.description: List of available broadband connection types (valuelist: property_broadband_value_list)- available in UK only

attr_last_flooded_date.description: Last flooded date - available in UK only

attr_has_flood_defences.description: Whether the property has flood defences or not - available in UK only

attr_has_restrictions.description: Whether the property has restrictions or not - available in UK only

attr_private_rights_of_way.description: Any easements, servitudes or wayleaves - available in UK only

attr_public_rights_of_way.description: Property has public rights of way - available in UK only

attr_stopcock_location.description: Stopcock location - available in UK only

attr_water_meter_location.description: Water meter location - available in UK only

attr_electricity_meter_location.description: Electricity meter location - available in UK only

attr_gas_meter_location.description: Gas meter location - available in UK only

attr_has_gas.description: Property has gas (yes/no) - available in UK only

attr_pre_paid_gas_meter.description: Property has pre-paid gas meter (yes/no) - available in UK only

rural_annual_rainfall.description: Annual rainfall details for rural property

rural_soil_types.description: Soil types details for rural property

rural_carrying_capacity.description: Carrying capacity details for rural property

fields.description: An array of fields to return - all fields will be returned if this argument is not specified. Call describeModel for a list of supported fields.

extra_fields.description: An array of extra fields to read in from other services - none of this data will be returned unless explicitly requested. Call describeModel for a list of supported fields.

200.description: array The record after the update is complete
